description: Maps pharmacy-label manufacturer strings (e.g., truncated pharmacy-system mnemonics) to FDA labeler codes. Intentionally empty: Document A §UC-3 describes the need but supplies only illustrative examples, and no verified mapping source has been reviewed. Entries may only be added with a cited, verifiable source and must be filtered at runtime to labelers that hold an active product NDC for the identified RxCUI.

entry_schema.alias: string, upper-case as printed on label
entry_schema.labeler_codes: array of FDA labeler codes (4 or 5 digits, as published in the NDC Directory)
entry_schema.labeler_name: string, as published in the NDC Directory
